name: cb-parity-harness
description: AC1 battle-fidelity verification: recolour identity vs the bundle renders (A), reference-pipeline recolour fidelity for arbitrary summoned wizards (B), timing vs the reference constants (C), the four AC1 battle-fidelity criteria — distinctness, arena-composite, no-blank, FX-fidelity — measured on rendered output with declared tolerances and explicit PASS/FAIL verdicts (D), and CB-BUILD-015's id-keyed parity: given a wizard id, the 2019 reference pipeline and the new engine both run for that SAME id and are diffed per duel state against pre-registered tolerances (E). Node-runnable, no browser.

scripts.all: node check-a-gifs.mjs && node check-b-wizards.mjs && node check-c-timing.mjs && node check-d-ac1.mjs && node check-e-idparity.mjs
